data.one_liner: Create responsive and nested responsive layouts using a 12-column grid system.
data.what_it_does: Provides Responsive and Div widgets that split the screen into a 12-column system similar to Bootstrap or Materialize. It enables setting column sizes and offsets for different screen breakpoints (extra small, small, medium, large, extra large) and supports nested responsive layouts.
use_when: You want a Bootstrap-like 12-column responsive layout system in Flutter.
You need nested responsive layouts inside specific parent containers.
avoid_when: You are placing the responsive layout directly inside a horizontal scroll widget.
You prefer flex/percentage-based adaptive layouts without a fixed 12-column grid.
strengths: Familiar 12-column grid system inspired by web frameworks like Bootstrap.
weaknesses: Requires a finite width to work properly and cannot be placed directly inside horizontal scroll views.
Sum of offsets and column sizes must not exceed 12.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need automatic UI scaling, resizing, and responsive breakpoints across the entire app rather than just a 12-column grid.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer building responsive UIs using ScreenTypeLayout and builder functions instead of a column grid.
